net.guizhanss.gcereborn.utils

Class EntityCompat

  • java.lang.Object
    • net.guizhanss.gcereborn.utils.EntityCompat

  • public final class EntityCompat
extends java.lang.Object
    Method-level version safety for the mob snapshot (MobAdapter/AnimalsAdapter).

    The upstream MobCapturer copy calls a raft of post-1.8 Entity/LivingEntity/ Ageable methods: setGlowing/setInvulnerable/setCollidable/ setAI/addScoreboardTag (1.9), setSilent/setGravity (1.10), getAbsorptionAmount (1.15), getLoveModeTicks (1.16), and the 6-arg PotionEffect constructor + PotionEffect.hasIcon() (1.13). Those classes all exist on 1.8 (so referencing them never throws NoClassDefFoundError), but the methods do not, so each call is wrapped here: a captured/released chicken simply drops the unsupported fidelity fields on legacy servers instead of throwing NoSuchMethodError. Basic properties (health, custom name, age, baby flag, fire ticks) go through the always-present API and are handled by the caller.
